verses.41:53: سَنُرِيهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا فِي ٱلۡأٓفَاقِ وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ

meaning: The root أفق (Afq) primarily means to go one's own way, often into distant regions. It also signifies reaching the utmost degree in generosity, knowledge, or eloquence, as if reaching the horizon.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
